description: UAE Open Data Portal (Bayanat) is an open data portal listed in UAE Open Data Portal (Bayanat), an open data portal, published or maintained by Government of the United Arab Emirates (Bayanat). Bayanat is the official open data portal of the United Arab Emirates government. It offers a dataset search, an entity list, real-time data and a geo-data section, with topic pages for infrastructure, transport, environment, technology and others. Coverage: United Arab Emirates. The portal home page read on 2026-09-30 shows 3,573 datasets, 57 entities and 8,191 data resources; the largest publishers are the Federal Competitiveness and Statistics Centre (608 datasets), the Statistics Centre Abu Dhabi (328) and the health ministries. Dataset addresses use identifiers that change from one session to the next, so individual datasets could not be listed with stable links. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure and hazard data of this country. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-bayanat-uae-open-data-portal.
